text: **Ra.One** is a 2011 Indian superhero film produced by Red Chillies Entertainment, directed by Anubhav Sinha, and starring Shah Rukh Khan in a dual role as the protagonist G.One and the antagonist Ra.One. The film blends science fiction with family drama, exploring themes of father-son relationships and the rise of artificial intelligence. Set in a futuristic world, the story follows a video game where the protagonist G.One and the villain Ra.One gain sentience and enter the real world through advanced technology. Ra.One, with greater powers including shapeshifting and mind reading, becomes a threat to the protagonist and society, leading to a series of high-stakes action sequences. The film features a massive marketing campaign, including a ₹520 million budget, internet promotions, and a global release across over 4,000 screens, breaking records for the widest release of a Hindi film. It also includes a 3D version and extensive use of digital prints to reduce piracy. Despite mixed critical reception—some praising its visual effects and ambition, others criticizing its plot and emotional depth—the film was a commercial success, grossing ₹2.081 billion worldwide. It won the National Film Award for Best Special Effects and received numerous accolades for its technical achievements. The film sparked controversy over plagiarism and hacking, and it has since inspired a sequel, *G.One* , which is set to explore the world of the original film further.
